summary: Tested Pagesa/Borxhe debts feature end-to-end (backend pytest 10/10 after 1 fix + Playwright UI). Debtor list (customers & suppliers with balance>0, sorted desc), live remaining calc (700-200=500), payment save + balance update + history row (Borxhi para/Pagesa/Mbeti), 0 and over-payment rejection (UI + API), customer history drawer with chronological ledger and running balance, WhatsApp wa.me link, statement PDF A4 (200 application/pdf, contains BORXHI AKTUAL + ledger, 404 invalid id, 401 unauth), and /customers drawer regression all PASS.

minor.issue: Invalid ObjectId returned 500 (bson InvalidId). FIXED by testing agent with ObjectId.is_valid guard -> 404.

Returns (POST /sales/{sid}/return) reduce customer balance and sale.due_amount but are not ledger events; the difference is pushed into a synthetic 'Gjendja fillestare' opening row and the original sale row shows the reduced due_amount, so history after a return is not truly chronological. Consider adding return events to ledger.
Still use ObjectId(cid) without is_valid -> 500 on malformed id (pre-existing pattern).

issues: Drawer is dark (#0D131E) while the page is a light theme - visually inconsistent but readable
Supplier names are not clickable (no history/PDF for suppliers) - acceptable per scope, but user may expect parity

action_items: Optional: include return events in _debt_ledger so ledger stays chronological after returns
Optional: guard remaining ObjectId(...) calls with ObjectId.is_valid to avoid 500s
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1370+ lines - should be split into routers (customers, sales, payments, pdf)
customer_history sorts sales/payments desc then _debt_ledger re-sorts by created_at string - fine, but document_date (user-entered) is ignored for ledger ordering

Real customer 'Pllata' balance is 650 (not 700): a 50€ payment was created at 2026-10-20T15:18 BEFORE this testing session started (not by testing agent) - main agent/user should confirm it was intentional
